ln:4452439892.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Transaction Services - Sr Officer.

Principal responsibilities

  • Collaborate with relevant departments for Credit and Lending application by following the procedure;
  • Process the data maintenance based on the financial information and application documents which provided by customers;
  • Assist to establish the customer profile, including but not limited to loan status and terms.
  • Assist to prepare the credit services proposal and related loan offering letters;
  • Complete assigned tasks by requested timeline and meet quality requirements.
  • 主要负责根据业务流程与相关部门同事处理信贷产品申请；
  • 根据客户提供的财务信息以及相关申请材料进行既定银行信贷产品的资料处理
  • 协助建立客户档案，包括但不限于贷款状态，借贷履行条款。协助筹建客户信贷服务计划及其相关贷款手续；
  • 建立与保持良好的商业伙伴关系；
  • 按规定时间完成分配的任务并符合相关质量要求。

Requirements

  • College degree or above, any major
  • Ability to understand and interpret numeric data；
  • Ability to speak and understand Korean and English fluently, proficient in Cantonese is preferred；
  • Ability to learn, and flexibility of work with knowledge and skills;
  • Ability to work under pressure and Complete assigned tasks by requested timeline.
  • 大专或以上学历，专业不限；
  • 对数据有一定敏感度；
  • 具备良好的韩语( ‌TOPIK 5/6 证书)和英语读写能力；
  • 具备良好学习能力，灵活运用工作知识和技能。
  • 能够承受一定的工作压力和在规定时间内完成日常工作。

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4461088191.descriptionHtml:
HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Be responsible for successful implementation of Premier Acquisition strategies
  • Acquire new-to-bank customers via central or self-generated leads.
  • In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to complete simple retail sales.
  • Development of strong working relationships with relevant business areas (e.g., WPB, Marketing, etc)
  • Delivery high standard customer service to meet customer satisfactory
  • 负责中高端客户的开发，发掘关于银行服务的需求并发展为汇丰客户
  • 通过银行渠道或者自己开发的渠道成功获取新客户
  • 为客户提供优良的服务，完成基本的零售销售指标
  • 与相关业务领域建立牢固的工作关系（如：财富管理及个人银行业务部，市场部）
  • 提供高标准的客户服务，提高客户满意度

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of one year proven and progressive financial services and/or retail sales experience or equivalent
  • Sound knowledge of various forms of deposits, WEM product, mortgage, etc.
  • Knowledge of the constantly changing laws/regulations governing banks/finance industry, consumer trends, competitor offerings, economic and foreign currency markets
  • Strong presentation and sales skills
  • Objection handling techniques and work under pressure
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Customer service orientation
  • Attain appropriate professional and regulatory qualifications as required by market
  • Attain any internal standards as required by HBCN
  • 本科以上或同等学历
  • 至少一年金融服务或零售经验，或同等工作经验
  • 对各种形式的存款，WEM产品，抵押贷款等产品有充分的了解
  • 对行业法规，消费趋势，竞争对手的产品，经济和外汇市场趋势有较好的了解
  • 较好的演讲和销售技巧
  • 较好的异议处理技巧，能在高压下工作
  • 良好的人际交往和沟通能力
  • 以客户服务为导向
  • 根据市场要求获得适当的专业和监管资格
  • 达到汇丰要求的内部岗位标准

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4477678380.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Software Engineering.

Business:CIB Technology

Job ID：62635

Principal Responsibilities

Technology leadership for the Client Distribution pillar

  • Lead the end-to-end technology agenda for the Client Distribution pillar within DSG.
  • Translate business and product strategy into a clear technology roadmap and execution plan.
  • Partner with the Business Lead and Product Owner Lead to define priorities, sequencing, and delivery outcomes.
  • Ensure technology decisions support the pillar strategy, client experience goals, and long-term platform scalability.
  • Position AI Markets effectively as the digital distribution front door for DSG, ensuring the underlying technology supports a seamless, scalable, and differentiated client experience.
  • Represent the pillar in DSG-wide technology planning, governance, and prioritisation forums.

AI-enabled platform and digital capability leadership

  • Provide technology leadership for AI-enabled client distribution capabilities, including intelligent workflows, digital content delivery, data-driven services, and agentic or assisted user experiences where relevant.
  • Ensure AI capabilities are implemented in a way that is scalable, supportable, explainable where needed, and aligned with business value.
  • Partner with product, engineering, and control stakeholders to embed AI responsibly into client-facing workflows and services.
  • Bring sufficient understanding of AI/LLM-enabled platforms, orchestration patterns, and operational considerations to guide design decisions and delivery trade-offs.
  • Ensure AI-enabled solutions are integrated into the broader digital platform architecture rather than developed as isolated point solutions.

Delivery and execution

  • Own technology delivery across the Client Distribution portfolio, ensuring execution against committed outcomes, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Drive coordinated delivery across engineering teams, platform teams, architecture, control functions, and dependent pillars.
  • Ensure delivery is pragmatic, transparent, and aligned to business value.
  • Manage delivery risks, dependencies, and trade-offs across a complex stakeholder landscape.
  • Promote disciplined execution, clear accountability, and strong delivery governance.

Platform, architecture, and engineering direction

  • Shape the target technology architecture for Client Distribution in alignment with DSG and enterprise direction.
  • Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, secure, and reusable where appropriate.
  • Drive engineering quality, technical consistency, and sound lifecycle management across the pillar.
  • Partner with horizontal pillars and shared platform teams to leverage common capabilities and avoid fragmented solutions.
  • Support modernisation of client-facing platforms, APIs, workflow services, and digital channel capabilities.
  • Ensure AI and digital distribution capabilities are built on strong platform foundations with appropriate observability, supportability, and lifecycle controls.

Production stability and operational readiness

  • Be accountable for the operational health and production readiness of technology services within the pillar.
  • Ensure appropriate support models, monitoring, controls, resilience, and incident management disciplines are in place.
  • Drive continuous improvement in platform stability, service quality, and operational maturity.
  • Ensure new capabilities are production-ready and supported by appropriate runbooks, controls, and service ownership.
  • Oversee remediation of production issues and structural improvements to reduce recurring incidents.

Governance, risk, and control

  • Ensure the pillar operates within appropriate technology governance, risk, and control frameworks.
  • Bring a strong control mindset to all aspects of delivery and platform management, particularly for client-facing and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Ensure solutions are designed and operated with appropriate controls around data usage, access, model governance, resilience, auditability, and change management.
  • Partner closely with control, risk, cybersecurity, architecture, and governance teams to ensure solutions are well-managed and sustainable at scale.
  • Support effective management of audit, security, resilience, and regulatory expectations relevant to the platform estate.
  • Drive disciplined change management, release governance, and lifecycle controls across the pillar.

Stakeholder management and organisational leadership

  • Build strong partnerships across business, product, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and control teams.
  • Provide clear leadership communication on strategy, delivery progress, risks, and decisions.
  • Align stakeholders across competing priorities while maintaining focus on pillar outcomes.
  • Contribute to DSG leadership discussions on technology direction, operating model, and execution priorities.
  • Act as a senior technology leader for the pillar, fostering collaboration, accountability, and high standards.

People and team leadership

  • Lead and develop technology teams aligned to the Client Distribution pillar.
  • Set clear expectations on engineering quality, ownership, delivery discipline, and collaboration.
  • Build a strong leadership culture focused on execution, resilience, continuous improvement, and control awareness.
  • Support organisation design, capability build-out, and talent development as the pillar evolves.

Scope of the pillar

  • The Client Distribution pillar supports digital client channels and services across institutional and corporate client workflows, including:
  • Sophisticated pre-trade workflows
  • Pricing and execution
  • Post-trade and chat-enabled workflows
  • Channels including web, mobile, chat, and API-based distribution
  • Content and services including platform-based data feeds, risk services, AI Markets Premium, and data / AI-enabled / agentic workflows and services
  • AI Markets is a core part of this pillar as the distribution front door for DSG, providing a unified digital entry point for client and user interaction with DSG capabilities.

Experience

Knowledge & Experience / Qualifications

  • Significant experience in senior technology leadership roles within digital platforms, electronic channels, or client-facing enterprise technology.
  • Proven track record leading complex technology delivery across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Experience owning large-scale platforms or product-aligned technology domains with both build and run accountability.
  • Strong experience in managing technology strategy, architecture direction, and execution in a controlled enterprise environment.
  • Experience working closely with business and product leadership in a high-demand delivery setting.
  • Experience with AI-enabled products, intelligent workflow platforms, or data-driven digital capabilities in an enterprise setting is strongly preferred.

Skills And Capabilities

  • Strong strategic thinking combined with practical delivery focus.
  • Ability to lead across architecture, engineering, delivery, production support, and control dimensions.
  • Good understanding of AI/LLM-enabled solutions and the practical considerations for deploying them in production environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability across senior business and technology audiences.
  • Strong judgment in balancing pace, innovation, control, resilience, and long-term sustainability.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technology topics for varied audiences.
  • Strong leadership presence, with the ability to align teams around clear outcomes and standards.
  • Strong risk and control awareness, particularly in relation to client-facing platforms, data usage, and AI-enabled services.

Technical / domain familiarity

  • Good understanding of digital channels, APIs, workflow platforms, and client-facing technology ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled application patterns, orchestration layers, model integration considerations, and operational support requirements.
  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices, platform design, resilience, observability, and service operations.
  • Understanding of enterprise governance, security, risk, and control expectations.
  • Experience working in environments requiring strong coordination across shared services and platform dependencies.

Preferred Qualities

  • Strong ownership mindset with end-to-end accountability.
  • Able to operate effectively across strategy, execution, and operational detail.
  • Collaborative, pragmatic, and outcome-oriented.
  • Comfortable leading through complexity, ambiguity, and organisational change.
  • Focused on building scalable and sustainable technology foundations, not just short-term delivery.
  • Brings balanced judgment on innovation, AI adoption, and control requirements.

Success measures

  • Clear and credible technology roadmap for the Client Distribution pillar.
  • Strong delivery performance against strategic priorities and business outcomes.
  • Effective positioning of AI Markets as a scalable and trusted distribution front door for DSG.
  • Improved platform scalability, resilience, and operational maturity.
  • Strong governance, risk management, and control discipline across the pillar.
  • Responsible and effective adoption of AI-enabled capabilities within client distribution services.
  • A high-performing technology organisation with clear accountability and execution focus.

/51/LP/WX

About HSBC Technology China

We develop, implement and support software and IT services and processes that allow HSBC to remain at the forefront of high-quality banking systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***
